senses.definition: n.pr.m. (Palm. ידיבעל DHM in MV 10, 983 cf. Sab. n.pr. with ידע DHMZMG 1875, 612)—
a Benjamite 1 Ch 7:6, 10, 11, 𝔊 Αδειηλ, Ιεδιηλ, etc.
one of David’s heroes according to 1 Ch 11:45 appar. = the Manassite captain of 12:21 (Baer; van d. H. v 20), 𝔊 Ελθειηλ, Ιεδιηλ.
a Korahite porter 1 Ch 26:2 𝔊 Ιδερηλ, Ιεδιηλ.
